profile.headline: Senior Security Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I strive to design, prototype, and lead teams to develop great code that is clean, maintainable, testable, and can be refactored or extended easily.  I do this with the use of good interfaces, user story driven design, reusable code, proper documentation, automated testing, and continuous integration.  

I am very passionate about continually improving the way we build software.  I've helped lead my teams agile transformation, and enjoy agile coaching with my team and other teams.  I love breaking down huge problems into incrementally improving blocks of functionality.

positions.title: Software Architect & Agile Product Owner (Technical Product Owner)
positions.description:
Currently, I have been helping to build a thick client set top box (STB) that runs on linux and includes a web browser whose user interface is written entirely in javascript, css, and HTML. I am also focusing on learning more about several cloud technologies so that I can help our product transition from a thick client to a thinner client with more responsibilities pushed to the cloud.

My role on the STB team has been a combined Agile Product Owner and Software Architect for up to 7 cross functional scrum teams. I've authored, ranked, and worked with the scrum teams to deliver over 2000 user stories. As a technical product owner I break down the "what" user stories into "how" stories that can split up a large project's work across scrum teams. Those stories are split up to allow teams to deliver new functionality to others quickly and with high quality. The stories are organized to track overall project delivery objectives and status. I'm a firm believer in transparency and metrics to accurately represent the teams status to the rest of the business unit.

Previously I designed a flexible C++ interface supporting multiple conditional access systems while evolving the project to support multiple CPU architectures. Part of my role on this project was to develop several of the conditional access systems used by the new interface while gaining experience in software security, cryptography, and secure co-processors.

I also acted as a scrum master for 1-3 teams with sizes of 4-26 individuals, while working on various STB features with an overall team size of ~100 developers and testers. That work included leading a small team to build an automated test framework that will run tests on the STBs for use by both developers and testers. This will ensure our product can improve in quality as we start shipping 7 hardware variants from the same code base and launching major features to the code about every quarter.

positions.title: ResNet RTA
positions.description:
ResNet, Georgia Tech, Atlanta, GA 
Provided technical support to Georgia Tech residents for a wide range of computer and network problems:
	-Assisted residents with connecting to the network, setting up routers, addressing security concerns, and fixing virus and spyware problems.
	-Worked two semesters in the ResNet office answering calls as they came in.
	-Worked four semesters on the night-shift from home, taking calls that had built up over the day and resolving them as the resident's schedule permitted.
	-Logged call progress with Remedy, and weekly status reports were filed with the program manager.

positions.title: Network Administrator/IT Support
positions.description:
Spectral Response, Inc., Duluth, GA 
Worked seven summers at Spectral Response, performing a wide range of IT tasks:
	-Built, backed up, maintained, upgraded, and trained employees how to use the 120 desktops through the whole range of Windows Operating Systems.  
	-Responsible for the reliable operation of seven servers, the Checkpoint Firewall-1 and VPN-1, web site, Lotus Notes, databases, and network.  
	-Assisted in the migration of the Microsoft Access and Btrieve databases to a Pervasive SQL based system.  
	-Further responsibilities of this position included researching solutions to address IT issues, presenting findings to Senior Managers, and managing all purchases within budget objectives.
